stories.title: Microsoft quietly purges 32GB of RAM recommendations from its website — company reels from the effects of the memory shortage as it released 8GB base models for Surface laptops this year

sources.title: Microsoft quietly purges 32GB of RAM recommendations from its website — company reels from the effects of the memory shortage as it released 8GB base models for Surface laptops this year
sources.title_en: Microsoft quietly purges 32GB of RAM recommendations from its website — company reels from the effects of the memory shortage as it released 8GB base models for Surface laptops this year
sources.title_original: Microsoft quietly purges 32GB of RAM recommendations from its website — company reels from the effects of the memory shortage as it released 8GB base models for Surface laptops this year
sources.summary: Microsoft once recommended 32GB of RAM as a future-proof "no worries" upgrade for gamers, but it seems that it wants you to forget that it ever gave that suggestion. That's because laptop manufacturers, including Microsoft itself, has once again started selling models with a base configuration of 8GB of RAM as companies memory prices skyrocket out of control.
sources.summary_zh: 微软曾经推荐 32GB RAM 作为面向游戏玩家的面向未来的“无忧”升级，但它似乎希望你忘记它曾经给出过这样的建议。这是因为随着各公司内存价格飙升失控，包括微软本身在内的笔记本电脑制造商再次开始销售基本配置为 8GB RAM 的型号。
